name: WolfContextAction
meaning: wolf+0x640: reply of nearby object to msg 2 / 0x26, or zone-derived.

name: CTX_READ
meaning: signs; Wolf_DoAction sends target msg 1 (shared case 0x490c9a with 1,9,0xA,0xB,0x1C,0x1D,0x21,0x24)

name: CTX_TELESCOPE
meaning: returned by Telescope msg 2; Wolf_DoAction's shared case sends the target msg 1 (name inferred; elastic also returns 9 but for query 0x17)

name: CTX_CLIMB
meaning: climb: a CLIMBBOXES zone without flag 0x4000000 (target 0) or a climbable object box (Tree answers 0xf) -> WOLF_ST_CLIMB_ZONE 0x3f / WOLF_ST_CLIMB_OBJECT 0x40 (Wolf_ClimbStep); prompt UI string 0x35 "climb" (verified)

name: CTX_CLIMBBOXWALK_ENTER
meaning: a CLIMBBOXES zone with flag 0x4000000 (walkable) -> WOLF_ST_CLIMBBOXWALK_IDLE 0x41 (Wolf_ClimbBoxWalkStep); prompt UI string 0x43 "grip" (verified)

name: CTX_ELASTIC_TIE
meaning: elastic state 3 near another tree: Wolf_DoAction → Wolf_ClearActiveItem + target msg 1 (tie the second end)

name: CTX_ELASTIC_TAKE_BACK
meaning: WAS CTX_CANNONBALL. Elastic state 3 near its own tree: → Wolf state 0x70 (ClearActiveItem, msg 7 unties, RemoveFromWorld, Inventory_Add)

name: CTX_ELASTIC_RELEASE
meaning: elastic state 5 (prompt while holding the centre); (merged from WolfCtxAction CTX_ELASTIC_RELEASE) set in 0x72/0x73

name: CTX_SWIRLSIGN
meaning: SwirlSign_HandleMessage case 2 returns 0x1a to the Wolf in state 0/1 -> WolfState 0xaa (verified)

name: CTX_CANNON
meaning: returned by CanonSimple_HandleMessage in state 0 when the Wolf's x/z is inside _ACTIVATIONBOX; per the existing CTX_READ note, Wolf_DoAction handles 0x1C in the shared case 0x490c9a that sends the target msg 1 (dispatch inferred from that note)

name: CTX_LEVELDOOR
meaning: ->0xdc

name: CTX_CATAPULT
meaning: ->0xde

name: CTX_BUSH_TAKE_OFF
meaning: the take-the-bush-off prompt: Wolf_BushCommon 0x48c7c6 writes +0x640 = 0xe (not a carry put-down; that function is not a sheep-carry step)

name: CTX_CLIMBING
meaning: set in states 0x3f/0x40; its prompt is UI string 0x3f "let go" (g_wolfCtxPromptStrIds) (merged from WolfCtxAction CTX_CLIMBING)

name: CTX_CLIMBBOXWALK_LEAVE
meaning: inside; action leaves; its prompt is UI string 0x44 "let go" (g_wolfCtxPromptStrIds) (merged from WolfCtxAction CTX_CLIMBBOXWALK_LEAVE)

name: CTX_BLEAT
meaning: set in model-set-3 ground states; its prompt is UI string 0x3e "bleat" (g_wolfCtxPromptStrIds) (merged from WolfCtxAction CTX_BLEAT)

name: CTX_BOO
meaning: set in model-set-5 ground states; its prompt is UI string 0x40 "boo" (g_wolfCtxPromptStrIds) (merged from WolfCtxAction CTX_BOO)

name: CTX_SQUIRM
meaning: set in state 0x4f; its prompt is UI string 0x4a "squirm" (g_wolfCtxPromptStrIds) (merged from WolfCtxAction CTX_SQUIRM)

name: CTX_NONE
meaning: ctxAction.action = 0 when nothing is in reach (inferred)

name: CTX_USE
meaning: DoorWorld/bull reply 1; Wolf::DoAction's shared case sends the target msg 1; coverAction.action == 1 is the cover side (inferred)

name: CTX_USE_0A
meaning: Wolf::DoAction shared 'send msg 1' case; no replier found in the census (inferred)

name: CTX_USE_0B
meaning: same shared case; no replier found (inferred)

name: CTX_PIPE
meaning: Pipe2 replies 0x1d to the Wolf

name: CTX_SAVE
meaning: MCardManager replies 0x21 within 300 units (and to the CinematicsManager)

name: CTX_BONUS
meaning: BonusManager replies 0x24 to the Wolf near it
